uniform.title: School uniform & appearance
uniform.intro: One uniform for every learner, worn identically across our NECTA and Cambridge wings. Please note: school uniform and club fees are communicated separately from the annual tuition schedule.

items.name: Cream polo shirt
items.detail: Sky-blue collar and cuff trim, school crest embroidered on the left chest.

items.name: Navy blue trousers or skirt
items.detail: Plain navy trousers or knee-length skirt worn by primary and pre-primary pupils.

items.name: Head veil (girls who wear it)
items.detail: Plain white or sky-blue trim, with the school crest embroidered cleanly on the front.

items.name: Navy sweatshirt
items.detail: Optional for cool mornings and rainy days, with the school crest on the chest.

items.name: Shoes & socks
items.detail: Black closed-toe school shoes with navy or white socks.

items.name: Sports & PE kit
items.detail: School PE shirt and navy track bottoms/shorts; house-coloured bibs issued on Sports Day.

items.name: Stationery & exercise books
items.detail: Included directly in your monthly fee structure for both NECTA and Cambridge streams.

items.name: Lab coats & aprons
items.detail: Provided by the school for science practicals and creative art sessions.

uniform.buy: Uniform details and sizing are provided at the admissions office upon registration.
uniform.note: No child is ever sent home for a missing uniform item; the office keeps spare stock and helps families sort it out.
